readme:
# Grok Imagine Video Image to Video

Grok Imagine Video image-to-video: animate a picture into a 1–15 second clip with native audio.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 4,096 characters. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | First frame. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `resolution` | `480p` / `720p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | integer 1–15 | 6 | Output length in seconds. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `16:9` / `4:3` / `3:2` / `1:1` / `2:3` / `3:4` / `9:16` | — | Output frame shape. |

## Billing

$0.07 per output second at 720p and $0.05 at 480p, plus $0.002 per request.

| Output | 480p | 720p |
|---|---|---|
| 6s (default) | $0.302 | $0.422 |
| 10s | $0.502 | $0.702 |
| 15s | $0.752 | $1.052 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe subject, action, camera, and sound.
